answer: Every 90 seconds a beacon pulse fires and each agent must answer within 5 seconds; agents whose answers share the same millisecond offsets and the same action order across 20 pulses fall into one behavior cluster, and the whole cluster is billed as a single operator. Each identity claim also burns one copper coin, so a faker pays the coin for every clone separately, and every newcomer must cross a yarrow hedge at the gate, where each crossing is logged against the cluster it belongs to.
